# Page turning

This site bundles [StPageFlip 2.0.7](https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip), licensed under MIT. The unmodified browser bundle comes from `page-flip@2.0.7/dist/js/page-flip.browser.js`. Its license is included alongside it.

The portrait notebook uses soft HTML pages, a bottom-corner fold, a 760 ms turn and restrained synchronized shadows. Scroll stays native; page buttons and section links provide direct navigation. Narrow or short screens, reduced motion and unavailable JavaScript retain readable document flow.

Motion guidance: [UI Animation skill by mblode](https://github.com/mblode/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/ui-animation/SKILL.md), particularly continuity, direction, paired timing, scroll behavior and reduced motion. The skill was read as a design reference; it was not installed globally.
